info.title: Oxistream API
info.description: HTTP API of the Oxistream server. State-changing requests must send an `Origin` (or `Referer`) header of this instance.

post.summary: Sign in with a local account.

403.description: Account disabled, local accounts disabled, or foreign origin

post.summary: End the current session. Succeeds without a session, too.

get.summary: The signed-in account.

post.summary: Back-channel logout: the provider ends sessions server to server.
post.description:
Signs out the sessions with the token's `sid`, or all sessions of its `sub`. Configure
`{PUBLIC_URL}/api/v0/auth/oidc/backchannel-logout` as the client's back-channel logout URL.
Needs no `Origin` header or session.

400.description: Invalid, replayed or unexpected logout token

get.summary: Where the provider sends the browser back after sign-in.
get.description:
On success, starts a session and redirects to the target given to `/auth/oidc/login`.
Unknown identities get a new account; the first account of an instance becomes an admin.
Failures redirect to `/login?error=` with `oidc_denied`, `oidc_failed`, `oidc_unavailable`,
`oidc_disabled` or `account_disabled`.

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Error code if the provider did not authorize the request.

302.description: To the sign-in target, or to `/login?error=`

get.summary: Start single sign-on with the configured provider.
get.description:
Redirects the browser to the provider. Failures redirect to `/login?error=` with
`oidc_disabled` or `oidc_unavailable`.

parameters.name: redirect
parameters.description: Same-origin path to continue to after signing in.

302.description: To the provider's authorization endpoint, or to `/login?error=`

set-cookie.description: Short-lived `oxistream_oidc` cookie holding the login state

post.summary: Create a local account and sign in. The first account of an instance becomes an admin.

403.description: Local accounts or registration disabled, or foreign origin

get.summary: Channel header and the first page of its videos.
A page of a channel's past, current and upcoming livestreams.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order of the first page; later pages keep it. Defaults to `latest`.

get.summary: A page of a channel's playlists.
Search within a channel's videos.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query; required unless `continuation` is given.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type, defaults to `all`. Pass the same type with `continuation`.

400.description: Invalid channel ID or missing query

get.summary: A page of a channel's shorts.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order of the first page; later pages keep it. Defaults to `latest`.

get.summary: A page of a channel's videos.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order of the first page; later pages keep it. Defaults to `latest`.

get.summary: Videos of subscribed channels, newest first.
Watched videos, most recently watched first.

delete.summary: Clear the whole watch history, including resume points.

get.summary:
Started but unfinished videos, most recently watched first. Videos known to be shorts are
left out.
Whether the watch history is paused.

put.summary: Pause or resume the watch history.

delete.summary: Remove one video from the watch history. Succeeds if it is not in there, too.

get.summary: Basic information about this instance.

The signed-in user's liked videos, most recently liked first. Likes stay on this
instance and are never sent to YouTube.
Whether the signed-in user liked a video.

put.summary: Like a video, shorts included. Idempotent; liking again keeps the original date.

delete.summary: Remove a like. Succeeds if the video was not liked, too.

get.summary: YouTube playlists the signed-in user follows, ordered by title.
Whether the signed-in user follows a YouTube playlist.

put.summary:
Follow a YouTube playlist. Idempotent; new playlists are fetched in the background and
then kept up to date by the feed worker.

delete.summary: Stop following a YouTube playlist. Succeeds if not followed, too.

put.summary: Mark the videos of a followed playlist as seen, resetting `new_video_count`.

get.summary: The signed-in user's playlists, most recently changed first.

parameters.name: video_id
parameters.description: Report for each playlist whether it contains this video, in `contains_video`.

post.summary:
Copy a YouTube playlist into a new private playlist, which can then be edited. Copies at
most 5000 videos; unavailable ones are skipped. Like any local playlist, the copy holds each
video once: a repeated video keeps its first place.

404.description: Not found, private, or a mix (`reason` is `mix`)

get.summary:
A playlist with its items. Private playlists are only visible to their owner; unlisted
ones to anyone with the ID, including anonymous users.

404.description: No such playlist, or not visible
No such playlist of the user
No such playlist of the user

put.summary: Append a video. Idempotent; a video appears at most once per playlist.

404.description: No such playlist of the user, or no such video

delete.summary: Remove a video. Succeeds if it is not in the playlist, too.

404.description: No such playlist of the user

put.summary: Move a video to another position.

404.description: No such playlist of the user, or video not in it

put.summary: Remember which item the owner is playing, for continuing later.

404.description: No such playlist of the user, or video not in it

get.summary:
Progress of several videos, e.g. for the progress bars of a list. Videos never watched
are left out.

post.summary:
Record how far the signed-in user got into a video. Ignored while history is paused and for
videos known to be shorts.
post.description: The body is JSON, sent as `application/json` or, for `navigator.sendBeacon`, `text/plain`.

204.description: Recorded, or ignored while history is paused

get.summary: Progress of one video, to resume where the signed-in user left off.
Resolve a YouTube URL to a video, channel or playlist ID.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: YouTube URL, path (`/@handle`, `/watch?v=…`), ID or handle.

get.summary: Search videos, shorts, channels and playlists.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search query; required unless `continuation` is given.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Result type, defaults to `all`. Pass the same type with `continuation`.

get.summary: Search suggestions for a partial query.
Channels the signed-in user subscribed to, ordered by name.
Download the signed-in user's subscriptions as a file.

post.description:
Accepts a YouTube Takeout `subscriptions.csv`, a NewPipe, Invidious or Piped JSON
export, or an OPML file; the format is detected from the content. Idempotent. Only
channels given by ID or `/channel/UC…` URL can be imported. New channels are fetched
by the feed worker over the following minutes.

requestBody.description: The exported file as is, at most 5 MiB

get.summary: Whether the signed-in user is subscribed to a channel.

put.summary: Subscribe to a channel. Idempotent; new channels are fetched in the background.

delete.summary: Unsubscribe from a channel. Succeeds if not subscribed, too.

get.summary: Trending videos of the instance's region (`OXISTREAM_TRENDING_REGION`).

schema.description: YouTube has no general trending list anymore, only these destination pages.

get.summary: Video details and related videos.
DASH manifest of a video, with all stream URLs pointing to the proxy.

404.description: Not found, unavailable, live or without playable streams

get.summary: Seek preview thumbnails as a `WebVTT` track, with cues pointing into proxied sprite sheets.

404.description: Not found, unavailable or without storyboard

get.summary: A YouTube playlist with the first page of its videos.

404.description: Not found, private, or a mix (`reason` is `mix`)

get.summary: A further page of a YouTube playlist's videos.

404.description: Not found, private, or a mix

AuthCapabilities.description: Which sign-in methods this instance offers.

local_enabled.description: Local accounts with username and password.

oidc_enabled.description: Single sign-on via `OpenID` Connect, started at `/api/v0/auth/oidc/login`.

oidc_name.description: Label of the single sign-on button; `null` without single sign-on.

registration_enabled.description: New local accounts can be created.

require_login.description: Anonymous users cannot use the API or proxy.

has_live.description: The channel has a Live tab.

has_shorts.description: The channel has a Shorts tab.

username.description: 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores. Case-insensitive for sign-in.

reason.description: Machine-readable detail, e.g. the unavailability reason.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

FieldError.description: Why a request field was rejected.

FollowedPlaylist.description: A YouTube playlist the signed-in user follows, as last fetched by the feed worker.

oneOf.description: Absent for auto-generated lists like albums; `avatar` is always empty.

new_video_count.description:
Videos added since the user last opened the playlist. Only the first 500 videos of a
playlist are tracked.

title.description: `null` until the playlist was fetched once, shortly after the first follow.

unavailable.description: The last fetch failed, e.g. because the playlist was deleted or made private.

video.description:
From the metadata cache; `title` is the video ID and `channel` is absent while the
metadata is unknown.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

paused.description: Progress reports are ignored while paused; existing history stays.

ImportFile.description: A subscription file as exported by another app.

playlist_id.description: YouTube playlist ID; mixes cannot be imported.

already_subscribed.description: Channels in the file the user was already subscribed to.

skipped.description: Entries that cannot be imported, such as handles, custom URLs or other services.

skipped_entries.description: The first skipped entries, as given in the file.

LikeState.description: Whether the signed-in user liked a video.

video.description: From the metadata cache: `channel` is always set; view counts are not.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

total.description: Number of liked videos in all pages.

end_session_url.description:
For sessions started via single sign-on: the provider's end-session URL to navigate
to, which signs out there, too (RP-initiated logout). `null` otherwise.

logout_token.description: Signed logout token (JWT) from the provider.

index.description: Zero-based target position; past the end moves the item to the end.

OAuthError.description: OAuth 2.0 error response, as the back-channel logout spec asks for.

contains_video.description: Whether the playlist contains the video asked for with `video_id`; absent otherwise.

last_video_id.description: The item the owner last played, to continue from. Only shown to the owner.

thumbnails.description: Of the first item; empty for an empty playlist.

is_owner.description: Whether the signed-in user owns the playlist and so may change it.

PlaylistDetails.description: A playlist with its items, in order.

video.description: `channel` is always set; view counts and dates are not.

is_course.description: YouTube presents the playlist as a course.

ProgressReport.description: A progress report from the player.

oneOf.description: `null` if the video was never watched.

start_seconds.description: Start offset in seconds for video links with a timestamp.

continuation.description: Pass to `continuation` to fetch the next page; absent on the last page.

corrected_query.description: Set when YouTube searched for a corrected query instead.

SubscribedChannel.description: A channel the signed-in user subscribed to.

name.description:
`null` until the channel was fetched once, shortly after the first subscription,
unless an import provided it.

id.description: Unique per video: the language code, prefixed with `a.` if auto-generated.

TrendingCategory.description: YouTube has no general trending list anymore, only these destination pages.

UpdatePlaylist.description: Fields to change; absent fields stay as they are.

description.description: Plain text; links are written out as URLs.

duration_seconds.description: Missing when the player data could not be fetched.

published_text.description: Localized, human-readable publish date as shown by YouTube.

storyboard_url.description: `WebVTT` thumbnails track for seek previews; absent without storyboard.

subtitles.description: Empty when the player data could not be fetched.

VideoProgress.description: How far the signed-in user got into a video.

updated_at.description: When the video was last watched.

oneOf.description: Absent for auto-generated lists like albums.

is_course.description: YouTube presents the playlist as a course.

last_update_text.description: Localized text as shown by YouTube, e.g. `Last updated on Feb 16, 2026`.

video_count.description: As reported by YouTube; hidden unavailable videos make the list shorter.
